verdict.rationale: Publishing operating hours, per-day limits, or session timeouts is a fair question for a state online business-filing portal, but nothing in the evidence pack discloses any of these for Washington's online filing flow. The docs only list filing services by name. The in-person counter note covers a same-day fee for walk-in service, not online-flow hours or timeouts. The DOR probe shows only a JavaScript shell with no readable content.
